digest.title: Morning overview
digest.description: One message with what is overdue and due today for you (and nobody's tasks).

assigned.title: Assigned to you
assigned.description: When someone else gives you a task.

unblocked.title: Can start now
unblocked.description: A task that waited for another one is ready.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: The day before a bill is due ("Pay tomorrow: Watergroep · € 52,30"), and every few days while it is overdue.

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.description: A task's reminder, at the time set on the task (to the people on duty, or whoever added it). Also during quiet hours: you chose that moment.

page.title: Tasks
page.description: Jobs in and around the house: who does what, where and when.

hints.none: Whenever: it stays in "Whenever" until you give it a date.
hints.day: All day. Reminders count back from 09:00.
hints.moment: At that time; it sits at that hour in the calendar.
hints.slot: A block from start to end in the calendar, e.g. 10:00–12:00. Reminders count back from the start.
hints.days: All day on every day in between; due on the last day. Reminders count back from 09:00 on the first day.

placeholders.title: e.g. Clean the gutters
placeholders.notes: Anything worth knowing: tools, where the ladder is…

hints.place: Optional. A room or an outdoor zone, which also shows whether it's inside or outside.
hints.rotate: One person at a time, in the order picked; the next one is up after each time.
hints.reminder: A push notification to the people on duty (or to you when nobody is), also during quiet hours. All-day tasks: counted from 09:00.

form.description: Materials can be added on the task's page once it is saved.

complete.title: “{{title}}” done?
complete.description: Add a note if something is worth remembering for next time.
complete.recurringDescription: It comes back on its next date. Add a note if something is worth remembering.
complete.notePlaceholder: e.g. Used two bags of potting soil

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.description: The task and its history are removed.
delete.withMaterials: The task, its history and its materials on the shopping lists are removed.

place.title: Tasks
place.empty: Nothing to do here right now.

none.title: No tasks yet
none.description: Add the jobs in and around the house: cleaning the gutters, the weekly vacuum, insulating the jacuzzi…

mine.title: Nothing on your list
mine.description: Nothing is assigned to you right now. Enjoy it.

ready.title: Nothing ready to start
ready.description: Every open task is still waiting for materials.

done.title: Nothing done lately
done.description: Tasks done or skipped in the last 30 days show up here.

filtered.title: No tasks match
filtered.description: Try another person, place or inside/outside.

errors.dueDateRequired: A repeating task needs a first due date.
errors.unknownHabitant: Pick each person once, from this household.
errors.alreadyClosed: This task was already done or skipped.
errors.forbidden: You can only complete tasks assigned to you.
errors.cycle: That would make the tasks wait for each other.
errors.linkedDelete: A linked task can't be deleted; skip it instead.
errors.timeNeedsDate: A time needs a due date.
errors.endTimeNeedsTime: A timeslot needs a start time.
errors.endTimeBeforeStart: The end has to be after the start.
errors.startDateNeedsDate: Several days need a last day.
errors.startDateAfterEnd: The first day has to come before the last day.
errors.daysTooLong: At most a year from the first to the last day.
errors.daysAllDay: Several days are always all day: no time.

project.label: Project
project.empty: No tasks yet. Add what needs doing, like “Buy materials” and “Start tiling”.

allDone.title: All done
allDone.nothingLeft: Nothing left on the list. Enjoy!
allDone.later_one: {{count}} more on the list for later.
allDone.later_other: {{count}} more on the list for later.

origin.vouchers: From income (meal vouchers that expire soon)
origin.other: From another part of the app

hold.title: Put “{{title}}” on hold?
hold.description: It stays on the list with its due date (and still shows overdue when late), marked as blocked until you resume it.
hold.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The invoice looks wrong; recalculate it first

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet: write what you found out or what you're waiting for.

blocked.toast: “{{title}}” is still waiting for other tasks.
blocked.title: “{{title}}” is still waiting
blocked.description: It waits for: {{titles}}. Complete it anyway?

links.title: Depends on
links.addDescription: Waits for: this task can't be done before the other one. Blocks: the other one waits for this. Related: just a reference.

linked.formHint: This task follows where it comes from: its title, type and due date update by themselves. You can change who does it and the notes.
linked.directDebit: Paid by direct debit: no task needed.
linked.noPayTask: A payment task appears two weeks before the due date.

payTasks.title: Keep payment tasks in sync
payTasks.description: Gives every unpaid expense you pay by hand a “Pay …” task (due the day before), and completes or removes it when the expense is paid, changed or deleted.

reminders.title: Send task reminders
reminders.description: Every minute: pushes the reminders that are due. A reminder missed by less than 30 minutes (server down) is sent late; older ones are skipped.
